title: Can the app do it?
instruction: You are writing a method for a bill-splitting app. Mark the steps the app can carry out without guessing.
debrief: An app can only carry out a step that can be done in one single way. “Sensibly”, “fair” or “a bit” mean nothing to it.

items.text: Divide the total by the number of people
items.why: Clear and doable: you divide one number by another.
What is sensibly? The app doesn’t know.

items.text: Round the share down to whole cents and add the remainder to the first person on the list
items.why: It says exactly where the extra cent goes.

items.text: Whoever ate less should pay less
items.why: The app doesn’t know who ate how much, or how much less.

items.text: Repeat until all the differences are zero
items.why: A clear end condition: the method will finish.

items.text: Send the money to whoever it is fair to
items.why: Fair is an opinion, not a step.
